d:
Planning a trip to New Zealand? This is the perfect North Island road trip itinerary you don’t want to miss!
• Where we stayed:**
In this video, we explore one of the most beautiful travel routes in New Zealand — starting from Auckland and covering some of the most iconic destinations including the magical Waitomo Glowworm Caves, scenic Taupo, and geothermal wonders near Lake Taupo.
• Our Journey:**
Auckland → Waitomo Glowworm Caves
Waitomo → Taupo (overnight stay)
Taupo → Geothermal Parks (Wai-O-Tapu / Wairakei area)
Relaxing at Lake Taupo
